keeper_rear_assembly.actual_insertion_direction: +Z from rear toward the seated position
keeper_rear_assembly.checked_sweep_direction: negative Z from the seated position
keeper_rear_assembly.continuity_argument: The final keeper surfaces are exclusively horizontal or vertical planes and cylinders with vertical Z axes. At each XY position its occupied Z intervals therefore have planar lower boundaries. Extruding every downward planar face to the common rear limit and uniting these extrusions with the seated keeper covers the continuous negative-Z approach wherever carrier material exists. No sloped or curved lower boundary was found that could be omitted by the downward-planar-face selection.
keeper_rear_assembly.sequence_condition: The bank, sensor yokes, printed pins, wedges and cables are fitted after the rear keepers. The checked electronics references remain in place during the keeper approach.
keeper_rear_assembly.scope: Nominal CAD geometry and the stated sequence only; physical fit, hand access and print tolerances are not proven.

required_new_part_scope.note: All eight camera wedges are shortened in R04; do not reuse the original full-length camera wedges.
